proof: Map $\emptyset$ to the empty set and each singleton $\{i\}$ to $(i,1)$.  For a singleton and $\emptyset$, the positive example is inconsistent with $\emptyset$; two different singletons are separated by either positive example.  Thus the mapping is positive and non-clashing.  A size-$0$ mapping cannot work for distinct concepts.
name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Singletons plus empty set
